verdict.rationale: Jira is a project and issue-tracking product, not an AI coding agent, so restoring a coding agent's session to a prior checkpoint is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Jira running coding-agent sessions or keeping checkpoint version history. Its Rovo AI features cover automations and task breakdown, and its MCP server serves other agents, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
